headline: [Previous day after-market] Samsung Electronics turns positive, SK Hynix falls less… top market-cap stocks strong
summary: Top market-capitalisation stocks, including Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, mostly showed strength in after-hours trading compared with regular trading, according to Korea Exchange data.
why: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are the two largest memory chip makers, and their share moves influence the Korean benchmark index and the global semiconductor sector.

impacts.name: Samsung Electronics
impacts.why: Shares rose in after-hours trading relative to regular session prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

impacts.name: SK Hynix
impacts.why: Shares fell less in after-hours trading, a smaller decline than in the regular session.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
